overall_notes: The paper is well-described and the extraction was mostly accurate. Key findings: (1) The paper introduces a novel NLG task - Exemplar-Based Expository Text Generation; (2) Uses comprehensive evaluation including traditional metrics (ROUGE, BLEU, METEOR), factuality metrics (NLI-E, NLI-C, Halluc), and task-specific LLM-judge metrics; (3) Both LLM-as-judge and human evaluations were conducted with strong alignment between them; (4) The RePA framework shows superior performance in balancing imitativeness and adaptiveness.
